description: Movie showtimes: what's playing in a city, at one cinema, or where one film is showing, with times and formats (2D, 3D, IMAX) per day for today and the next few days. Use when someone asks what movies are on, when a film is playing, or what a cinema is showing, e.g. 'what's on in Mumbai tonight', 'Dune showtimes in Pune', 'PVR Phoenix Palladium showtimes'. Pass location (city, country); add movie for one film's times across cinemas, or theater for one cinema's full listing. Returns found, summary {days, theaters[], movies[], shows}, days[] {day, date, theaters[] {name, address, distance, link, showings[] {type, times[]}} for area and movie searches, or movies[] {name, link, showings[]} for a theater search}, movie (title, rating, runtime, genres when known), booking[] (local booking sites) and fetchedAt. From Google's public showtimes: strong in India, the US, UK, Europe and most large cities; thin in some countries (e.g. Nepal). Read-only: it does not hold seats or book tickets; send the user to the cinema link or booking site. Not charged when no showtimes are found. 3 free searches a day per person (no wallet needed; automatic over MCP, header X-Exepal-Trial: 1 over HTTP). Price: $0.02 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

country.description: Optional two-letter country code, e.g. in, np, us (guessed from the location when left out)

language.description: Optional language code for titles and day names, e.g. en, hi (default en)

location.description: City and country, e.g. Mumbai, India or Kathmandu, Nepal or Austin, TX

movie.description: Optional: one film's title, to get its times at every cinema in the location

theater.description: Optional: one cinema's name, e.g. PVR Phoenix Palladium or QFX Civil Mall, to get everything it is showing
